fresh_source_build.reason: Podman repeatedly hit Docker Hub EOF/connection reset while fetching base images even with the requested proxy. Docker then fetched both base manifests successfully through the same proxy, but the first build failed on an incomplete conda download and the retry made no progress for more than ten minutes in dependency installation before being cancelled. No current-source image was produced.

existing_image_gate.failure_evidence: After POST /delete, /v1/models was empty but ray::VllmBackend remained alive and continued holding 5810 MiB GPU memory; scheduler reported free_gpu=0.0. This violates the sleep post-condition and prevents valid lifecycle timing.

plot_policy: No value is plotted because the physical sleep post-condition was not met.
